RESPONDENTS EXHIBITS: NIL ---------------------
 /TRUE COPY/
 P.A.TO JUDGE K.V.
 A.K.JAYASANKARAN NAMBIAR, J.
 -------------------------------
 W.P.(C).NO.10883 OF 2017  -----------------------------------
 Dated this the 29th day of March, 2017  J U D G M E N T
The petitioners have approached this Court aggrieved by Exts.P16 and P17 stop memos issued to them preventing them from carrying on their business operations.

In Exts.P16 and P17 stop memos,
it is seen that the respondent Panchayat has, based on the objections received from members of the public, alleged that there are violations of the Kerala Panchayat Raj Act that has been occasioned by the petitioners.
The case of the petitioners is that there is no such violation as alleged against them and they can establish this before the respondent Panchayat.
2. I have heard the learned counsel for the petitioners.
In the nature of the orders that I propose to pass, I do not deem it necessary to hear the respondents.

On a consideration of the facts and circumstances of the case as also the submissions made across the bar I dispose of this writ petition with the following directions:
1. The petitioners shall prefer their objections on Exts.P16 and P17 stop memos within a week from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
2. The second respondent shall, on receipt of the objections from the petitioners, and within a further period of two weeks therefrom, consider and pass orders on the objections preferred by the petitioners after hearing them.
3.

It is made clear that till such time as the orders are passed by the second respondent, as directed, and the orders communicated to the petitioners, the petitioners shall be permitted to carry on their activities based on Exts.P1 and P14 licenses already issued to them.

Sd/-
